# Integration & Packaging Requirements Checklist: Functional Integration (Turn-1 Whole)

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review ("unit tests for English") for US-07 — the Turn-1 functional-whole integration, console packaging/hardening, and documentation reconciliation. Tests whether the requirements are complete, clear, consistent, measurable, and cover the needed scenarios — NOT whether the implementation works.
**Created**: 2026-11-22
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete. Unchecked items are NOT an implementation blocker.

**Focus**: Integration completeness · packaging & security hardening · documentation reconciliation
**Depth**: Standard · **Audience**: PR reviewer

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the exact services that must start under the single command enumerated and consistent everywhere they appear (five services)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the single orchestration command itself identified as a requirement, or only described as "one command"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK003 Are startup-ordering and health-gating requirements defined for every dependency edge, not only console→backend? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements stated for what data must be present to drive the live render (gold/simulator C6-008 snapshots)? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK005 Does the spec define the required contents the shipped console artifact must NOT contain (build runtime, source, dependency tree) with enough precision to review? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the required environment settings for the console (API base / same-origin proxy default) specified as documentation requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is the "~5 second" refresh cadence given a tolerance or acceptance band so a reviewer can judge pass/fail objectively? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "healthy" defined per service (what a health status means) rather than left implicit? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the "single origin" / same-origin topology defined precisely enough (one origin forwarding `/api/v1`) to distinguish it from a CORS setup? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the mandatory security headers named with their required values/directives, or only by header name? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "headers that reveal the technology stack or versions" defined by concrete examples so absence can be judged? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the distinction between the "no-data state" and an "error state" described in terms a reviewer can tell apart? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "non-blocking stale indicator" specified clearly enough to distinguish it from a blocking error or a crash? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK014 Are the service names and count consistent across spec, plan, tasks and the docs they require reconciling? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001/§FR-017]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the "no new behavior, contract or business logic" constraint consistent with every other requirement (no requirement implicitly asks for new logic)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the contract version (1.0.0) referenced consistently between the corridor-state and source-status requirements and the assumptions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK017 Do the non-root UID and security-header requirements stay consistent with the project's phased-adoption stance (adopted early, not contradicting a deferral)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010/§FR-012]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK018 Can "100% of services report healthy" be objectively verified from the stated requirement? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK019 Are the five validation cases each stated with an objective pass condition rather than a narrative? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK020 Is "zero schema drift" measurable against a named contract artifact and version? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the "zero exceptions" hardening criterion (non-root, assets-only, headers present, stack headers absent) expressed as discrete checkable conditions? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the new-contributor onboarding outcome (SC-006) framed so "without undocumented steps" can be judged objectively? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for the primary flow (stack up → console loads live C6-008 against the real backend)? [Coverage, Spec §US1]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for the estimated-source alternate flow (label, no alert)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK025 Are requirements defined for the backend-interruption-and-recovery exception/recovery flow? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK026 Are requirements defined for the console starting before the backend is ready (startup race)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the ingestion-isolation scenario (stopping api/frontend must not stop ingestion) captured as a requirement, not only a task? [Coverage, Gap]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK028 Is the no-current-snapshot boundary condition specified as a distinct required state? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the live-response-vs-committed-contract mismatch handled by a required stop-and-decide behavior rather than silent edits? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK030 Are requirements defined for inline scripts/styles the production build may emit vs. the strict CSP (how a conflict is resolved)? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK031 Are repeated/flapping backend outages (not just a single interruption) considered in the stale-indicator requirement? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK032 Are the security-hardening requirements (non-root UID 10001, mandatory headers, stack-header omission) stated as outcomes independent of a specific proxy technology? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-010/§FR-012]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the refresh cadence the only timing requirement, and is it explicitly scoped so the deferred ≤2s map SLO is not implied? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK034 Are the existing coverage gates (>80% backend and frontend) referenced as still-in-force non-functional obligations for this story? [Non-Functional, Plan Testing]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the data-freshness / isolation expectation for ingestion stated so it is not weakened by adding the frontend service? [Non-Functional, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK036 Is the assumption that US-05 (backend read API) and US-06 (console) are complete and merged stated and validated? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK037 Is the assumption that contracts remain at 1.0.0 and are consumed unchanged documented with the consequence of a mismatch? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK038 Are the out-of-scope items (auth/RBAC, CORS topology, image registry/scan gate, orchestration beyond compose) explicitly bounded so the reviewer knows what is excluded? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK039 Is the availability of gold/simulator C6-008 data documented as a precondition for the end-to-end validation? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK040 Is the reverse-proxy choice (Nginx) identified as a dependency introduced by this story, with its config treated as reviewable? [Dependency, Plan Primary Dependencies]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK041 Is the final reverse-proxy config directory name resolved in the requirements/plan, or left for implementation to decide? [Ambiguity, Plan Source Code]
- [ ] CHK042 Does "project documentation (README, docs, agent context)" name the specific documents/locations that must be reconciled so completeness can be judged? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK043 Is there any conflict between "no new behavior" (FR-013) and bringing forward hardening (non-root, headers) that previously did not ship? [Conflict, Spec §FR-013 vs §FR-010/§FR-012]
- [ ] CHK044 Is a requirement & acceptance-criteria ID scheme (FR-/SC-) established and used consistently for traceability? [Traceability]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation. Unchecked items here do NOT block `/speckit.implement`.
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
